drhp.business: MT Educare provides academic tutoring and competitive-examination coaching through a hybrid model combining physical classrooms with its Robomate+ digital learning platform. The company delivers its services via a network of company-owned centres and franchise partners, serving students preparing for school examinations and competitive entrance tests. The Company has been undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) since December 16, 2022, with operations run under the supervision of a court-appointed Resolution Professional.

litigation.note: The Company has been under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) since December 16, 2022 following admission of an application by Operational Creditor Connect Residuary Private Limited under Section 9 of the IBC. A Resolution Plan approved by the Committee of Creditors remains pending before the NCLT, Mumbai Bench, partly on account of an appeal by Shamrao Vithal Co-operative Bank (SVC Bank) pending before the NCLAT, New Delhi, over possession/valuation of a property (Mangalore) taken over by the bank. Disclosed in the Directors' Report / Corporate Governance Report / Notice of AGM.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The Company has accumulated losses, negative net worth, and current liabilities exceeding current assets; auditors flagged material uncertainty on the Company's/Group's ability to continue as a going concern, dependent on the outcome of the CIRP and NCLT approval of the resolution plan.
- The Company has been under CIRP since December 16, 2022; the approved Resolution Plan remains pending final NCLT adjudication, with an unresolved NCLAT appeal by a lender adding uncertainty to timing and outcome.
- The Company/Group defaulted in repayment of principal and interest to banks and financial institutions, resulting in classification of accounts as Non-Performing Assets.
- Outstanding loans, trade receivables, and other receivables are overdue/rescheduled for a long period; management considers them recoverable, but no impairment provision has been recognised, and auditors could not obtain sufficient evidence to assess this.
- Claims from operational/financial creditors, employees, and statutory authorities submitted to the Resolution Professional remain undetermined; final obligations and liabilities will only be settled once the CIRP concludes.
- The Company/Group has received various direct and indirect tax notices, but management has not provided sufficient information for auditors to quantify the potential financial impact.
- A property classified as Assets Held for Sale is under a lender's possession following an SARFAESI action, and its fair value has not been determined as management does not control the asset.
- Consolidated and standalone revenue declined year-on-year, attributed to reduction in student rollover enrolment.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthening the integrated learning ecosystem by combining classroom instruction with the Robomate+ digital platform.
- Expanding reach through company-owned centres, franchise partners, and technology-enabled platforms.
- Investing in faculty capability development, curriculum enhancements, structured assessments, and data-driven performance tracking.
